## Movin’ da balls

### Warmup

- Moving Goofballs
- Leg swings
- Arm circles
- Abe Vigodas

### Thang

Movin’ da balls

Broke out into 2 teams to compete against each other (including a brief Socs vs Greasers-like stare down). Each round, the goal was to try to empty their bucket of golf balls (each side started with 20 balls in their bucket).

- Each round, PAX will complete a different exercise for 5-6 minutes.
- Earn 1 ball for each 10 reps completed
- When balls are earned, PAX can take ball from their bucket and run it to the other side to drop in the other team’s bucket.  Then return to complete more reps.
- You may complete the jailbreak travel with either 1 or 2 balls in hand.  You are allowed to carry a ball for another PAX as long as you have no more than 2 balls total in hand.
- Always run on the right side of the cones.  Traffic lanes.
- While you may be going fast…still need proper form.
- If a team empties your bucket completely, the round is over.  Otherwise, at the end of the round (~5-6 minutes) count up to see how many in your bucket. Whichever side has fewer buckets in their own bucket wins that round.
- Losing team takes enough balls to the other side to even buckets up for the next round.

Round 1: Burpees
Round 2: Curls
Round 3: Overhead Presses
Round 4: Merkins (lightning round)

## Coin Flip Decides Your Fate

### Warmup

- Grass Grabbers

### Thang

Each round consisted of exercises detailed below.  Each round built on the previous round, up to round 5, then you work your way back down.  Following each round, each HIM flipped a coin.

- HEADS - Mosey to the base of the hill, Deion up the hill, mosey back down, Deion back up the hill, mosey back down and return to starting point.
- TAILS - Jog/run around the outside of the field - approximately 250 meters.
- DROP - If you drop the coin, you do double whatever side of the coin is facing up: Heads = 4 Deions up the hill, Tails = 2 trips around the field

## Party's Over! Back To Work!

### Warmup

- Goofballs - 15 IC
- LBAC - forward and back - 10 IC
- Grady Corns - 10 IC
- Pretzel Taps - 10 IC
- Grass Grabbers - 8 IC

### Thang

PAX split into four groups and reported to four corners of 20-yard square. At each corner was a coupon exercise and non-coupon exercise. PAX started with coupon exercise, coupon-traveled to next corner, then non-coupon exercise and non-coupon travel for three corners until back with their coupon. Rinse and repeat. Goal was to move coupon all the way around the square. Made it a little over half way - coupons moved two stations, PAX moved 7 stations.

Stations:

- 15 Blockies &lt;--&gt; 15 Burpees
- 30 Curls &lt;--&gt; 30 Merkins
- 20 Piston Squats &lt;--&gt; 30 Air Squats
- 20 Overhead Press &lt;--&gt; 20 SSH IC (4 count)

Movement:

- Murder Bunnies &lt;--&gt; Bear Crawls

### Mary

Man Overboard:
Tried something new. PAX circled, faced to the right, and did a Big Boy Sit-up followed by an American Hammer to "row-row" the boat. One PAX, the man overboard, ran around the circle back his position, then the next guy ran, and so on.
It took too long. Adjustment should have been to have PAX on opposite sides of the circle go at the same time to cut the time in half.

## Weird Stuff at Black Diamond

### Warmup

Hairy Rockettes, Ssh, knee pulls , high knees, quad pulls, butt kicks, Merkin, lap on the path (checking for slick spots)

### Thang

Weird Stuff beatdowns are meant to bring never before attempted exercises (or combo of exercises) together to 1) use muscles we don’t commonly use or to use them in a different way, 2) spark some creativity for future beatdowns, 3) have some fun

Buy-In:  Head up the Hill to the Speed limit sign .  8 Toad Hope followed by 8 Running Strides on repeat until you get to the sign, then carefully run down the hill.  (.25mi up and .25mi down)

3 Rounds:

- 8 Pull-ups alternating grips without dropping (e.g. standard pull-up, one hand forward one backward pull-up, chin up, other hand forward other backward pull-up, etc.)
- 8 Single Cross Legged Squat (HW) - place ankle on opposite knee, one leg squat to sit on bench, switch legs, lift to stand with other leg
- 8 Merkin Circles Hands - merkin then move hands in one direction while keeping feet in place
- 8 Merkin

Circles Legs - Merkin then move feet in one direction while keeping hands mostly in place

- 8 Kracken Sit-ups - Sit-up (hands touch ground over head and in front of feet), Sit-up opposite elbow to opposite knee, Sit-up other opposite elbow to opposite knee… that’s 1
- 1 Lap around path (.33mi) alternating 8 running strides with 8 karaoke strides all the way around

Buy-Out: Head up the Hill to speed limit sign.  8 of your choice (toad hop, bear crawl, or lunges) followed by 8 Running Strides on repeat until you get to the sign, then carefully run down the hill (.25mi up, .25mi down)

## If ya ain't first yer last

### Warmup

`Foot touches QC`
`8 to 1 Motivators IC`
`Movie Stars IC`

### Thang

`Court Stretch approximately 25 yards`

- `Each PAX starts at 'start line' and travels prescribed traveling exercise (start at the same time)`
- `The first PAX to get to the Finish Line yells to indicate.`
- `Other PAX stop where they are at and ALL PAX mosey back to start line for next 'race' NUMBER`
1. `Bear Crawl`
2. `Right Leg Hop`
3. `Left Leg Hop`
4. `2 Broad Jumps, 10 Merkins, repeat to finish`

`MOSEY AROUND TRACK`

`Field Stretch : approximately 35 yards`

- `Each PAX starts at 'start line' and travels prescribed traveling exercise (start at the same time)`
- `The first PAX to get to the Finish Line yells to indicate.`
- `Other PAX continue to finish, PAX that finishes goes to next race # while other PAX repeat previous race #. Each first place PAX of the LOWER # continues on to the next Race # until all PAX are on the next race # together.`

`Repeat until ALL PAX are done with all race #'s. For example, because we had 8 PAX this means the first place finisher of #1 did 1 Murder Bunnies and 7 Rifle Carries where the last did 8 Murder Bunnies before moving on to the Rifle Carry.`

1. `Murder Bunnies (each PAX did 1 to 8)`
2. `Rifle Carry (each PAX did 1 to 15)`
3. `Rev Murder Bunnies (each PAX did 1 to 9 before time)`
4. `Farmer's Carry (2 PAX did 1 to 2 before time)`

- Second Super Tabata set: Coupon squat thrusts; decline merkins with hands set wide (feet on coupons); v-ups; burpees; sumo squats; coupon curls; taint-scrapers; Ukrainian twists
- Partner exercises: Breaking into two-man teams, rotate teams running with med ball to yellow statue by pool-entry building; their return signaled the end of each set of partner exercises, which were: hand-slap merkins; tandem squats trading coupon at apex of squat; hand-slap big-boy sit-ups. ## Mind Games (-᷅_-᷄๑)

### Warmup

Played the best song ever to get us warmed up! Put on _Around the World_ by Daft Punk and did a SSH every time they say _Around the World_. 7 minutes long and comes out to over 140 SSH. ### Thang

We played a game of cards with 3 decks. Each suite represented an exercise and the number on the card represented the reps. Face cards counted for 10 reps. Each man took 2 cards and called out what they were and we went in a circle and just repeated. Whenever a Joker was pulled the PAX had to solve a riddle to avoid running 2 laps around the track. - Hearts: Merkin
- Clubs: Taint Scraper
- Spades: Coupon Squat
- Diamonds: Burpee

### Thang

Concept borrowed from a previous beatdown by PAX. Divided PAX into 4 groups of either 4 or 5 PAX. Each team was given a sheet containing a list of exercises and reps that they needed to complete among the team. PAX marked progress as a team by marking off reps in 25 increments upon completion. Also, PAX took turns having 1 PAX from the team run out to the far light and back, while the others completed exercises. Reps of exercises for each team were as follows:
300 Merkins
300 Little Baby Crunches
300 Curls
300 Overhead Presses
300 Bent Over Rows
300 Goblet Squats
300 Coupon Jumpovers (EW)

When a team completed all their needed reps, they moved over to help another team finish theirs until all reps by all teams were completed.

## Q-School - Gherkin Edition

### Warmup

- SSH x 15 IC

&gt; Calling Cadence
&gt; “The next exercise is…” [pause] “Side Straddle Hop!” (or name of other exercise)
&gt; “Starting Position…” [pause] “Move!”
&gt; “In Cadence…” [pause] “Exercise!” (begin count 1..2..3)
&gt; Altering inflection on last rep signals that it’s time to “HALT!”
&gt;     ◦ Creates rhythm which distracts the mind from the task at hand
&gt;     ◦ Builds teamwork by synchronizing PAX and creating focus
&gt;     ◦ Not knowing the number of reps discourages budgeting of effort; you get used to going as long as you have to

- Learning to Batwing x 12

&gt; For Squatober! Incorporate monthly CSAUP or challenge activities in your beatdowns if you can!

- Jog the lake -

&gt; Remember you have help! If for any reason you want someone to grab a part of the workout while you are out there, speak up. Let someone lead the 12 while you mingle and make sure the rest of the PAX are pushing themselves.

### Thang

- 11's + pay the piper. Murder bunny, 5 jump squats at halfway, jailbreak.
- Goblet Squat and Bonnie Blair
- To Gherkin Ridge!
- Bernie Sander up, 3 burpees, mosey down. Rinse and repeat 5 times

&gt; Be willing to pivot if necessary! The flag fell over, so we all owed 15 burpees and the hill was one way to make that harder. No one knows what you’ve got planned for the day, so if you mess up or need to pivot, act like that was the plan all along. When falling, DIVE!

### Mary

&gt; From Something About Mary - “I can do 8 minute abs in 7 minutes.” Well we're better than that, so we can do abs in 6 minutes! Typically meant to be a 6-ish minute core workout.

- Flutterkicks IC x 25

&gt; Use Mary as an opportunity to let newer guys who haven't Q'd learn in a low risk environment. This gets them used to calling cadence, speaking loud enough for people to hear, and leading a group of men.

## Let the Deck Decide

### Warmup

- Overhead arm claps x 12 IC
- Willie Mayes Hayes x 10 IC
- Grass grabbers x 10 IC
- Downward dog (calf stretch) for 15 seconds

### Thang

Played F3 Poker - split into two teams, each team takes turns drawing a card off the top of the deck of cards. Each card represents an exercise and after each team has 5 cards, the team with the best poker hand gets to pick an exercise to complete for 50 reps or 60 seconds.

Number 2-10 use the card for numbers of reps. Jack-Ace are noted below.

Hearts = chest press
Diamonds = goblet squats
Clubs = burpees
Spades = blockees

Jacks = 45 seconds of tricep extensions
Queens = 45 seconds of lawn mower pulls
Kings = 45 seconds of curls
Aces = 45 seconds of merkins

Played two hands. Got feedback on how to add some cardio elements and other fun aspects to future BDs.

### Mary

- Hearts = Big boy sit ups
- Diamonds = V ups
- Clubs = flutter kicks
- Spades = Spider-Man planks

working on Pulling Movements to Balance out Pushing.

Q had a 70# sand bag with - 35’ rope attached to each end. PAX divided in to 2 groups of 3.  (Q being the 7th man) ea. side note Will take turns pulling the Sand Bag 30-35feet . Side Pulling will have team mates doing pulling or rowing exercises. (Think bent over rows, Lawnmowers, Grave Diggers. Other side is doing Squats, Pushing Or lifting Exercises. These are AMARP with time based on pace of Puller pulling the sand bag.

Round One:
Ea. Man rotates till their turn to Pull the Sand bag.
Completed 7 rounds - 3 each side + Bonus of Q Pull.
Round Two:
Murder Bunny Madness!
7 more rounds of Pulling the Sand bag. This time! The team opposite of the puller will do Murder Bunnies to the Middle. Pulling side will accompany their pulling mate with Resurrection Bunnies. Back and forth we went while we rotated to our turn to Pull.

Round Three:
Teams in single file line, facing middle . Q stacked their coupons in a wall of blocks. We did 2 rounds of Bucket-brigade moving the blocks from the front to the back passing them one at a time. As quick as possible. To the back and then from back to the middle again. Last Round included Manmakers!  Pulling the Blocks through to each side (both ways).

4. 90degree Hold -&gt; Pull-ups

- Partner Beatdown

▪︎ 1 Partner does a Deion sanders down 50yards, performs 10 jungle boy squats, and jailbreaks back while other partner does the following exercises. Rotate.

- Round 1: Sandbag Power Cleans x50
- Round 2: Sandbag Chest Press x100
- Round 3: Sandbag Squats x150
- Round 4: Sandbag Rows x200
- Station 3 - PAX
- Burpee Bear Crawl Beastmode

▪︎ PAX lines up on one side of the Streaker's field. Perform 1 Burpee to start then Bear Crawl to cones on the opposite side (around 50 yards) then add 1 Burpee (so 2 Burpees) and then Bear Crawl back to the other side and perform 3 Burpees. Just go up by adding 1 Burpee each time. Repeat until station time is up.

- Forge tradition: Have a random PAX member pick an exercise and then PAX rolled a dice into a mug. Take that exercise and whatever the diced rolled and multiple by 10. We did 90 flutter kicks in cadence.

BONUS IRONPAX CHALLENGE - WEEK 5

IRONPAX CHALLENGE – WEEK 5 “RETURN OF THE KRAKEN”

Format: This workout is 5 rounds for time.

Measure out 10, 20, and 30 yards

Set an EMOM timer for 5 minutes.

5 Kraken Burpees every 5 minutes. When the EMOM timer goes off, stop what you’re doing and do 5 Kraken Burpees (down for burpee - 3 hand-release merkins – finish burpee with jump).

Ex. If you’re on your 9th thruster and the timer goes off, do your 5 Kraken Burpees, continue with your 10th thruster up to 20.  If you're traveling via Murder Bunny when the timer goes off, stop and complete the 5 Kraken Burpees, then continue your travel.

Round 1

- 10 BDE Burpees (burpee/Bonnie Blair/jump squat)
- 10 yard Murder Bunny
- 10 BDE Burpees(burpee/Bonnie Blair/jump squat)
- 10 yard Reverse Murder Bunny

Round 2

- 20 Thrusters
- 20 yard Murder Bunny
- 20 Thrusters
- 20 yard Reverse Murder Bunny

Round 3

- 30 Bonnie Blairs (the Hard way)
- 30 yard Murder Bunny
- 30 Bonnie Blairs (the Hard way)
- 30 yard Reverse Murder Bunny

Round 4

- 20 yard Murder Bunny
- 40 Jungle Boi Squats (2 Spoonz Style)
- 20 yard Reverse Murder Bunny

Round 5

- 50 Merkins
- 10 yard Murder Bunny
- 50 Merkins
- 10 yard Reverse Murder Bunny

Scoring
Total time to complete the workout

### Thang

Q broke the PAX up into two six man groups and placed one group at each Station. PAX had three exercises to complete and then they could travel as a group to the next Station. Q was assisted by PAX who placed 1 cone every 3 parking spaces in the middle parking aisle. Every three parking spaces PAX would stop the travel and perform an exercise that increased by one with each cone they passed. Do the exercise and then continue the travel to the next Station.

Station 1: Coupon Work

- 75x Coupon Press
- 50x Curls for the Gurls
- 25x Coupon Thrusters

Travel: Ladders
Bear Crawl and at every cone do a Merkin and add one Merkin as you get to each cone for a total of 36 Merkins!

Station 2: Core Work

- 75x Leg Raises
- 50x Freddy Mercuries HW
- 25x Rope Climbers HW

Travel: Glutes
Lt. Dan's (Right Lunge, Left Lunge, Squat, repeat) plus a Squat Jump at every parking space with a cone. Eight cones total for 36 Squat Jumps.

## Side-Bull

### Warmup

PAX Merkins, Side-Straddle Hops, Imperial Walkers, Hairy Rockettes, and Runner-Stretch

### Thang

Side-Bull Partner Workout

1. Round 1: 5 Rounds

Partner one holds coupon overhead as partner two alternates backpedaling and sprinting to series of lights - partners switch upon return

2. Round 2: 3 Rounds

Partner one holds a plank as partner two performs bear crawl to first light, sprint to next light and back, followed by crab walks to partner. Partners switch upon return

3. Round 3: 2 Rounds - Partner Movement

Partners wheel barreled to first light, moseyed to next light and back, followed by switching position of wheel barrel carry back to starting line. At line 50 chest presses and 50 air squats were performed

4. Round 4: 1 Round

Perform 20 partner rows (officially called Side-Bulls), mosey to far light and back, switch partners and perform 20 more side-bulls.

## Gone Fish'n for New Ways to Accelerate

### Warmup

SSHs - IC
Goofballs - IC
(TRYING THIS New THANG out!) The F3 HAKA!
&gt; consists of 3 Exercises: (_Each was given a Purpose &amp; a Name)_
&gt;

- Sumo Walkers (We are STABLE) - Q demo’d as similar to Hill-Billy Walkers but in a low squat movement
- Shields-Up! (STRONG as One) - like Warming up Serena's Back but hands hitting our Forearms With strength
- For the Sky-Q (Lifting Each other UP - That's Living the 3rd!) - alternating Forward Lunges with Hands raising up to the Sky.

Did each above IC. Then put them together  IC - 3X

### Thang

PAX went on a Ruck with TWO Implements!  The  on a 35ft, 1" Nylon Boat Rope AND Q 70# Ruck Sandbag.   Took the levee trail.  Goal was to make 3 stops and try out this New Tool of Acceleration.

Stop One:  .75 miles in we rucked up to the top of the levee.
Ea. of us took turns Casting the HOOK down the sloped levee and pulling it back up. (Fun Fact:  the Hook weighs about 20lbs. ) We did this 3 times while the partner performed OH Presses with the Sandbag AMRAP-style till the other was done Casting.  Once each of us had a chance to Cast the Hook and pull it back we continued the Ruck along the top of the levee.

Stop Two: another .75 miles we Did the Same Casting and pulling back up while the partner performed Deadlifts with the Sandbag. Once each of us had a chance to Cast the Hook and pull it back 3Xs we continued the Ruck, heading back to the parking lot, but first heading down the levee to take the sidewalk path back.

Continued Ruck back to Flags.

IronPax Week 4 is here! Hope you’re ready to run…and a lot of other things.

Format: This is a for time workout.

Measure out 400 meters however you want or utilize a 400 meter track.
Have a white board, poster board, or even a pizza box with the workout progression written out so you don’t forget the “NEXT EXERCISE“.

THE WORKOUT
50 Jump Rope
1 mile run
25 Burpees
50 Jump Rope
400-meter run
25 V-Ups
50 Jump Rope
400-meter run
25 Leg Raises
25 Jungle Boi Squats – 2 spoons style (we will even do demonstrations)
50 Jump Rope
400-meter run
50 Jump Rope
400-meter run
100 Big Boy Sit-ups
50 Jump Rope
1 mile run

Modify by Distance: Half the running: ½ mile run, 200 m run, ½ mile run

Modify by exercises: Based on your ability, substitute any exercise, modify as necessary

if difficulty with jump rope:

Do less reps of jump rope or
jump over a line in road forward/backward or side to side
Modify by reps: Less reps for any exercises as necessary

Modify by speed: Slow down and cap the workout when PAX finish

Scoring:
Total time to complete the workout

MODIFIED OPTIONS:
Scale by reps - 10 reps for all

Scale by adjusting run rounds or distance: x5 instead of x6 @ 400m OR x6 @ 200 m.

PLEASE USE A GOOD MEASURING TOOL FOR 400M RUN. TRY TO KEEP THE ROUTE ON PAVEMENT AND CONSIDER RUNNING 200M AND TURNING AROUND TO COME BACK IN ORDER TO DO SO.
NOT ALL SCHOOL TRACKS ARE 400M PER LAP SO PLEASE ADJUST THE ROUTE AS NECESSARY.

## All in all we’re just another brick in the wall

### Warmup

- Goofballs
- Area code motivators
- Bat Wings
- Harry Rockettes

### Thang

PAX built a wall with coupons (4 for the base, 3 each remaining course) then lined up side by side with one half facing the other to form a "runway".

First PAX in the line with coupon wall to his right grabbed his coupon from the top of the wall and traveled 25 yards to start rebuilding the wall at the other end, then joined the end of the other line. First PAX in this other line then moved w/o coupon to end of opposite line (diagonal). Rinse and repeat until the wall is complete at the other end. We are now in reverse order by position, our coupons are stacked in reverse order, and we are rotated 180 degrees, so we can start another round.

Rounds were specified as: Exercise for one side, non-coupon travel, exercise for other side, and coupon travel. PAX completed three rounds as follows:

"Earth Day":
Al Gore -&gt; Bear Crawl -&gt; Plank -&gt; Farmer Carrie
(Al Gores did 10 calf raises and Planks did 10 flutter kinks when they couldn't hold any longer)

"Prison Yard":
Heals to Heaven -&gt; Jailbreak -&gt; No Surrender -&gt; Rifle Carrie

“Blue Grass”
Side-straddle Hop -&gt; Bear Crawl -&gt; Hand-release Merkin -&gt; Monte Python

(Ran out of time, but Q was ready with a round 4 killer)
Boy Band -&gt; Dion Sanders -&gt; Burpees -&gt; Bear Trap

### Warmup

### Thang

Q’s broke PAX up into pairs and made them twins for the remainder of the Beatdown. Once twins were found they were given 1 minute to create a special patty cake/handshake. Every time anybody in the PAX calls out 'twinning' or 'twinsies' or 'patty cake' they have to find their twin and perform the handshake. Quite a lot of 'twinning' was called to say the least!

The main format for the Thang is similar to a Dora 1-2-3 but with more exercises. Twin 1 does the exercise while twin 2 runs 30 yards out cone and back. Switch out until the reps are completed and plank for the 6!

### Thang

Today there were options! 8 stations.  PAX numbered off into 4 groups.  Each group was assigned a station to begin at.  The station numbers were not in order and the PAX did not know where each station was.  If we started at station 4 we performed the exercises at station 4 and then there was some form of mosey and we had to guess where the next station was.  IF they guessed the right station they performed the exercise and then moved to the next station....IF they guessed wrong they had to use the same mosey back to their original station, perform that exercise again and then jog mosey to find the correct station.

## Backblast

### Thang

The Beast-  5 rows of cones were set up approx. 15 - 20 yards apart.  The idea was that at each set of cones we did 12 reps of an excercise then a movement with the coupon to the next set of cones and wash, rinse, and repeat.  Once you get to the last set of cones, we pick up the 6 have a 10 count and turn around and go back the other way.
Round 1:  12 burpees-&gt; Murder Bunny-&gt; CPR's-&gt; Murder Bunny-&gt; OH Press-&gt; Murder Bunny-&gt; Merkins-&gt; Murder Bunny-&gt; Curls-&gt; 10 count-&gt; Curls-&gt; Rifle Carry-&gt; Merkins-&gt; Rifle Carry-&gt; OH Press-&gt; Rifle Carry-&gt; CPR's-&gt; Rifle Carry-&gt; Burpees

## The Wall

### Warmup

SSH, Learning to Fly, Learning to Land, Willie Mays Hayes, Piano Tappers

### Thang

THE WALL
Everyone is lined up on The Wall doing the same movement while one member of the PAX moves all the Coupons/Bags/Balls to the top of The Wall. Once all items have been moved, the PAX worked together to break things down and we reset. Wall exercises included:

- Plank wall taps
- Wall Mountain Climbers
- Tricep Pushups, starting position is with your hand &amp; elbows on the wall, pushing so only the tris are working
- Decline Wall Mountain Climbers
- Toe reaches. Laying down with butt close to the wall and feet straight up, alternate arm reached towards toes
- Wall lunge

Final exercise: PAX Coupon Air Chair. PAX are all in air chair. Coupon starts at the end and PAX passed it to the front, once there, the first in line has to run it to the end where it starts over.

## Let's Play A Game

### Warmup

65x SSH (Bad cadence Halt )
30x High Knees (Good cadence Halt )

- 15x Grass Grabbers

### Thang

Q set up 4 goals at varying distances in the field. Each goal had a workout Station associated with it. The object of the game was for each team to kick a ball into a goal to avoid running 4 laps around the Streaker's track. Yes, missing a goal meant your group had to run 4 laps…

- Station 1: 30x sit-up to get-ups, 50x SSH, 10x Oh Yeahs!
- Station 2: 40x Chest Press, 30x Triple Bears, 10x Pickle Pounders
- Station 3: 30x Bobby Hurleys, 50x Curls, 10x Pickle Pointers
- Station 4: 30x Gravediggers, 50x Shoulder Taps, 10x Monkey Humpers

If members in a gorup finish quicker than others, then they pick up their 6's by planking.

Some groups faired much better than others but most had a good balance of running and doing movements at each Station. PAX’s group missed the first couple kicks and got a little over 2 miles in right off the bat! The objective was for each group to give their 3 members a chance at kicking the ball into the goal.

### Mary

We played _Animal Mirror_! The objective for this game is for the PAX to mirror and mimic the Q’s every movement. PAX immediately started with a barrel roll and continued to jump around and flop on the ground like an animal. The PAX enjoyed the show. Performance was performed to the tune of Crazy by Gnarles Barkley.

### Thang

FUN WITH COMPOUNDING
Partner up with a PAX of similar fitness level/someone who will push you

Each PAX is completing all exercises - Your partner is there to encourage you &amp; check/correct form

Start at parking lot baseline and complete the following exercises.  Complete first set, then Deion Sanders to 1st cone &amp; mosey back, second set, then Deion Sanders to 2nd cone &amp; back, etc. until you complete 5th set and Deion Sanders to 5th cone &amp; back.  Double the reps of exercises for each set.

Round 1 - Thrusters (start at 1 rep for 1st set, 2 reps for 2nd set, 4 reps for 3rd set, 8 reps for 4th set, 16 reps for 5th set)
Round 2 - Burpees (start at 2 reps for 1st set, 4 reps for 2nd set, 8 reps for 3rd set, 16 reps for 4th set, 32 reps for 5th set)
Round 3 - Curl Press (3 reps, 6 reps, 12 reps, 24 reps, 48 reps)
Round 4 - Flutter Kicks w/ Coupon Overhead, easy way (4 reps, 8 reps, 16 reps, 32 reps, 64 reps)

Pick up the six at the end of each round

PAX will complete as many rounds with a 15min. EMOM timer going of:
Running the 100yrds.  with timer going.  Every Minute the buzzer goes off, where every you are, stop and do 3 No Surrenders (this signals the number of Years Ireland fought the occupying English forces following the 1916 Easter Revolution) .

At the other end of the 100yd. Field, PAX will do 1 Prison Burpee (Q demonstrated) for the time PAX spent in Frongach prison in England.  Run Back to the other side and RINSE and REPEAT!  So Simple, It Sucked.

BONUS: _BearBrawls!  Never miss a chance at a Gumbo BD for this BONUS Thang!_  PAX split up in to two groups lining up on opposite ends of the Field. ## The Amazing Race

### Warmup

- SSH
- Learning to Fly
- Learning to Land
- Learning to Phelps
- Abe Vigoda
- Willie Mays Hayes

### Thang

A little play on the show Amazing Race. Tickets set out throughout the park with a mix of exercises and trivia. Working together as a PAX to complete the race.

Ticket 1 – THE FLAG
Challenge Card – 10 Burpees
Question. The US Flag in 1777 consisted of 13 stripes representing the 13 British Colonies and 13 stars representing 13 States. As additional States were added, additional starts were added to the flag. In 1822, Missouri’s star was added to the flag which increased the total number of stars to how many?
Correct Answer - 24

- Right Answer – Mosey to the Bathroom
- Wrong Answer – 10 Burpees and then Mosey to the Bathrooms

TICKET 2 – THE BATHROOMS
Challenge Card – Team Wall Sit on the outside wall. Each PAX calls out a 10 count down the line until moving on to the Trivia Card. Pair up before moving on.
Question. The average American household (2.6 people), how many rolls of toilet paper are used a year – within 10? Correct Answer – 409. Estimated due to COVID – 572 total.

- Right Answer – Mosey to the Government Center
- Wrong Answer – 10 Burpees and then Mosey to the Government Center

Ticket 3 – GOVERNMENT CENTER
Question. In what year was the town of Ballwin established, need to be within 10 years? Correct Answer – 1837 by John Ball

- Right Answer – Mosey to the Playground
- Wrong Answer – 10 Burpees and then Mosey to the Playground

Ticket 4 - PLAYGROUND
Challenge Cards – 3 Challenges throughout the Playground that all must be performed before moving on with your partner.

- 1. Swing Merkins (feet on the swing with a knee pull) to failure x 2
- 2. Dips to failure x 2
- 3. Pull-ups to failure x 2

Question. The first American playground opened in 1887 in what US city. Correct Answer –San Francisco CA.

- Right Answer – Mosey to the Tennis Courts
- Wrong Answer – 10 Burpees and then Mosey to the Tennis Courts

Ticket 5 – TENNIS COURT
Challenge Card – Amazing Race time, 2 teams needed.

- Teams planked in a parallel line like rungs of a ladder. PAX in back get up jump over the outside feet of the PAX, and assumed plank in the front until both teams crossed the finish line.
- Teams planked in a head-to-toe line. PAX in back bear crawl to front and assumed plank until the next PAX came to the front of the line.

Question. Soon to be retired tennis great, Serena Williams, has won how many combined Grand Slam Titles – combined meaning Singles &amp; Doubles? Answer – 39. 23 singles/14 doubles/2 mixed

- Right Answer – Mosey to the Volleyball
- Wrong Answer – 10 Burpees and then Mosey to the Tennis Courts

Ticket 6 – VOLLEYBALL COURT
Challenge Card – Medicine ball over/unders around the Volleyball court. Same two teams as before.
Question. In what year was Beach Volleyball introduced to the Olympics? Correct Answer – 1996

- Right Answer – Mosey to the Baseball Field
- Wrong Answer – 10 Burpees and then Mosey to the Baseball Field

Ticket 7 – BASEBALL FIELD (MARY)
Challenge Card – Field of Dreams – Homebase Triggerman

- Home Plate (Trigger Man). 20 American Hammers
- 1st Base. BBSU until relieved.
- 2nd Base. Flutter Kicks until relieved.
- 3rd Base.  LBC until relieved.

Question. The movie Field of Dreams was based off a novel, what was the name of that novel? Correct Answer – Shoeless Joe

- Wrong Answer – 10 Burpees and then Mosey to the Flag

## DEVIL'S BLACKJACK

### Warmup

- Willie Mays Hays IC
- Grass Grabbers IC
- High Knees IC
- LBAC IC
- Butt Kickers IC

### Thang

_PAX encouraged to wear 20 lb vests for the entirety of the beatdown._

Since the PAX were about to play a game of Devil's Blackjack, we started with an "Escape From Hell" as we ran up and down the Forby Road hill 1x (and battled some inner demons on the way up).

PAX then gathered sandbags and headed over to EHS football field where Devil's Blackjack was played:

- Similar to 11's, but we are doing 21's
- Start at goal line on football field and perform 1 sandbag clean &amp; press
- Run to other goal line and perform 20 merkins
- Run back and perform 2 sandbag clean &amp; press --&gt; run --&gt; 19 merkins --&gt; etc.
- 3 full decks of cards were placed on the sandbag goal line
- PAX were allowed to draw a card at the end of each round (if they were inclined to play)
- Dealer has 18 and PAX assumed to have an Ace in the hole
- If the dealer beats you, you must pay the man and run an extra down &amp; back before starting your next round
- If you draw a joker, you must complete 10 burpees &amp; an extra down &amp; back before starting your next round

PAX continued until 5:50 AM When Q called time. PAX made it the furthest getting to 16 sandbag clean &amp; press.

## Make Saturdays at Wet Willy Great Again

### Warmup

Goofballs
Area code motivators
Grass grabbers
Grady corns

### Thang

Part 1:
Each PAX drew a card from the deck.  Each card represented an exercise:

- Ace - Taint Scrapers
- King - Simbas
- Queen - Bonnie Blairs
- Jack - Lawn Mower Pulls
- 10 - Side Straddle Hops
- 9 - Wheel of Fortune
- 8 - Hand release merkins
- 7 - Grave Diggers
- 6 - Freddie Mercury
- 5 - Elf on a Shelf
- 4 - Squat and a half
- 3 - Curls
- 2 - Burpees

60-second tabata timer with 10 second rest, each PAX called out their exercise based on their drawn card.  Two rounds with the rest between rounds used to draw new cards.

Part 2:
PAX formed a 2-by-4 “raft” with the extra guy in the back - on their six with feet locked in their coupon, doing big-boy sit-ups with an American Hammer motion at the top to simulate rowing.  Back two PAX sprinted 50 yards and back, perpendicular to rowing direction, then brought coupons to front of the formation to move the raft forward.  Continued this pattern until the raft was 25 yards out, then turned around and came back.

Bonus round:
9-man 100-yard sprint relay, followed by 5v5 100-yard sprint relay race.

## You’ll Need a Rub Down After This

### Warmup

SSH
High Knees
Learning to Phelps
Willy Mays Hayes

Q emphasized importance of first warm up exercise being something that gets the body moving/blood flowing/muscles warmed up. More static stretches like grass grabbers for hamstrings should be done later, not first. SSH, goofballs, moseys are good examples of a good start to get the body warmed up before static stretches.

Today is the first Focus On Form Friday. Q chose: The Merkin
Showed form through demonstration with a few markers to look for -

- No flared elbows to save shoulders
- hands directly under shoulders
- Plank position should be tight, butt not in the air or sagging. Pull in the stomach and tighten glutes
- at bottom of movement hands should be near chest so it is not a straight up and down movement but a slight arc
- Full range of motion down and up

PAX partnered up and each had 60 seconds to perform the merkin while partner checked form to give feedback

~Switch~
Cut for time

Switch

## Backblast

### Warmup

- Copperhead Squats IC
- Willy Mays Hayes IC
- Grady Corn IC
- 10:1 Motivators

### Thang

Today, the workout would be centered around an Idea Q had about a better way to do Thrusters IC. Every PAX does a Thruster at a little bit different speed. Since Q Jam has been to do Coupon exercises IC lately, Q had been brainstorming a way to do them IC and keep the PAX Together, As One with Thrusters. It's not perfect, but it was Effective. These may not be new, but they were new to #ao_the_rock: Control Freak Thrusters!

Control Freak Thrusters: Thrusters done IC but not the 4 count. Ready Position is the Rifle Carry Position. Rifle Carry Position is held until the command "Down!". At that time, PAX are to do a Thruster then return to the RC Position. This would be done to start each round. Each round would consist of Control Freak Thrusters IC to start, then Jailbreak the given length of the Suicide, an exercise at the given light, then Jailbreak Back. The rounds went a little something like this:

1st Round:
Control Freak Thrusters IC
Jailbreak to the First line of cones
10 Breakdancer Merkins
Jailbreak Back

2nd Round:
Control Freak Thrusters IC
Jailbreak to the first line of cones, JB Back, Jailbreak to the second line
20 Hand Release Merkins
Jailbreak Back

3rd Round:
Control Freak Thrusters IC
Jailbreak to the first line of cones JB Back, Jailbreak to the Second Line of cones, Jailbreak Back, Jailbreak to the Third Line of cones
30 Sphinx Planks
Jailbreak Back

4th Round:
Control Freak Thrusters IC
Jailbreak to the First Line of cones, JB Back, Jailbreak to the Second Line of cones, Jailbreak Back, Jailbreak to the Third Line of cones, Jailbreak Back, Jailbreak to the Fourth Line
40 Shoulder Taps EW
Jailbreak Back

5th Round:
Control Freak Thrusters IC
Jailbreak to the First Line of cones, JB Back, Jailbreak to the Second Line of cones, Jailbreak Back, Jailbreak to the Third Line of cones
30 Bobby Hurleys/Shaqs!
Jailbreak Back

6th Round:
Control Freak Thrusters IC
Jailbreak to the First Line of cones, JB Back, Jailbreak to the Second Line of cones,
Jailbreak Back

7th Round!
Control Freak Thrusters IC
Jailbreak to the First Line of cones
10 No Surrenders
Jailbreak Back

The Six: Q and the PAX exercised with the Six at the cones and went back to the startling line together.

## Space

### Warmup

5to1 motivators
Abe Vagodas IC
Learning to Phelps IC
MovieStars on Qs count
Foot touches on Qs count

### Thang

4 stations at quarters around the track.

- PAX choose # 1- &lt;# of PAX in attendance&gt;
- Group Exercises at spot repeating until the scout returns.
- Starting with 1, a 'scout' PAX travels to the next spot w/ Coupon, does exercise for one round, then travels back, w/o Coupon, to the group
- The scout leads the group back to the new spot, rest of PAX take coupons with to next spot
- Repeat with the next PAX in order as the new 'scout'
- 1st Lap use prescribed exercises
- Subsequent Laps gives scout PAX 3 choices:
- (1) PAX can choose to take a 'support scout' with them or not
- (2) PAX can travel farther or shorter.

## THE CAN-AM VQ

### Warmup

10-1 motivators
Grass grabbers
Imperial walkers
Bat Wings
Lawnmowers

### Thang

Numbered off into two teams.
Two Hopscotch lines, Two Teams, Two Balls….because we are men. Two identical hopscotch lines are drawn on parking lot using sidewalk chalk.

It is a race; and there is a prize.
Sprint to the start of the Hopscotch lines.
Hopscotch carrying the ball overhead with both hands. When the end of hopscotch is reached, must throw the ball back to the next guy in line - from the end of the hopscotch line. Man who threw the ball sprints to the back of the line. Any ball drops result in 3 burpees for that team before they can continue.

While hopscotch is taking place each team will be using one coupon and doing one curl and one overhead press before passing the coupon to the next man.  End of the line returns the coupon back to the man he received it from and repeats exercise passing it back up the line to the front. While waiting for the coupon, Goofballs/Lunges/High Knees/Squats are performed.
Every time you touch the coupon, you switch to the next exercise (alternating between the 4).
Completion of race is when the last guy in the lineup completes his loop. Each team counts (out loud) the number of coupon reps and the team with the most reps imposes a 1 burpee penalty for every rep over and above the opposing team.

Losers: 5 burpees
Winners: Side straddle hops until losers finish (_or perform burpees/other exercise_).
This is in addition to the imposed burpees from whichever team had the most coupon reps.

Any coupon drops result in 10 burpees for the team at the end of each game cycle. (There were none)
Rinse &amp; repeat until Mary

## Speed Ball

### Warmup

SSH, Hairy Rockettes, Knee pulls, High Knees, Quad pulls, butt kickers, old man stretch, neck rolls, lap around track

### Thang

6v6 Speed Ball (also heard it called Arena Ball)

Basically, soccer rules (except no offsides) and you can run and throw the ball as long as it hits something other than the ground before touching your hands (e.g. another body part or another player).  If tagged with ball in hands , ball is turned over to opposing team. Can kick or throw ball in goal for a point.  This time we added that a ball headed into the goal from assist of someone on your team is 3points.  No out of bounds but generally allowed the ball to come back in play unchallenged when out.  After each score, other team does 10 burpees.

Think score was 5 to 7.  Winning team is represented in the first row of the boy band.

## The Forge at Wet Willy

### Warmup

Wayne &amp; Garth into Used Car Lot IC x 8
Bat Wings IC x 20 Each (Forward Arm Circles, Reverse Arm Circles, Seal Claps, Overhead Claps)
Grass Grabbers IC x 10
Side Straddle Hops IC x 100

### Thang

Homicide Ladder
Ok so Homicide might be a little strong but this was an awful out-and-back ladder. Q encouraged the PAX to push themselves but don’t hurt themselves; modify for ability but don’t cheat the movement if you can do it. Today’s beatdown is You vs. You to get AMRAP (as many reps as possible) in 45 minutes. This was intended to model what an IronPAX beatdown could possibly look like this September. While Q said to modify as needed, it was strongly encouraged not to modify if you could help it, because IronPAX is all about good form, full reps, and really focusing in on pushing yourself beyond what you thought capable before.

The field of Wet Willy was set up with rows of cones/lights spread out to maximize the use of the field. Each row was spaced about 12-13 yards apart. PAX lined up on the parking lot end of the field. Each row had a different exercise and modality of transportation between the starting line and that row. Here’s a breakdown of the layout:

- Starting Line: 10 Burpee block jump-overs every time you get to the starting line (aka 4 times per round)
- Row 1: Bear Crawl Drag to the first row, perform 20 CPR’s, Bear Crawl Drag back to starting line
- Row 2: Murder Bunny to second row, perform 30 Louganis, Murder Bunny back to starting line
- Row 3: Rifle Carry to third row, perform 40 Alternating Iso Merkins (EW), Rifle Carry back to starting line
- Row 4: Jailbreak with Coupon to fourth row, perform 50 Jungle Boy Squats, Jailbreak back to starting line

## “Don't fire until you see the whites of their eyes!”

### Warmup

- Willie Mays Hayes
- SSH
- High Knees
- Approximate 1-mile run to round it off

### Thang

Q broke PAX up into 3 groups of British (two groups of 5 &amp; one group of 4) and 1 group of Colonials (3 men total).

Each British group was given 2 -3 sandbags. The objective was for the British groups to get some or all of their sandbags to 3 different drop-off points. The British could only move their sandbags in a certain way. British had to get all sandbags delivered to any or all of the points to win the round.

The Colonials group had to complete 130 reps (number of dead patriots from Bunker Hill) of either Merkins, Burpees, Squat Jumps, Bonnie Blairs, or BBSU's. They were able to mix and match to get 130 reps. Each Colonial had to do essentially 43-ish reps. After completing 130 reps they could run and lock one of the drop-off points so that the British groups couldn't deliver their sandbags there.

Round 1: British had to do Sandbag Bear Crawl Pull Throughs to move the sandbags to their drop-off points. British won this round because the rules were still getting ironed out at this point.

Round 2: Colonials regrouped and came back with a vengeance. British had to do a Burpee Sandbag Tosses to move their sandbags. Colonials were able to lock all three points (390 reps completed!)

Round 3: British had to do Sandbag Plank Pull Throughs for this round. British regrouped and marched down the field. Colonials put up a brave defense but ultimately lost at Bunker Hill.

## Building Blocks of Fitness

### Warmup

- Grass Grabbers IC
- Imperial Walkers IC

- Side Straddle Hops IC

### Thang

Used concrete building blocks to construct (and deconstruct) towers. PAX individually performed exercises in a 2-4-6-8-10-8-6-4-2 (repeat if necessary) pattern.  After completing the exercises, PAX moved through the speed ladder and added or removed to the building blocks of fitness.  The tower was constructed and deconstructed down a line in the middle of the field at a series of 9 cones.  The first set of exercises were thrusters and merkins.  Do 2 reps of each move.  Through the speed ladder.  Perform your one construction task as appropriate.  Move back to repeat the exercises at the next level (4.  Then 6.  Then 8. Etc., etc.)  End of round 1.
Continued with the building and the general movement pattern.  The carry was changed to a double farmer’s carry.  This round the PAX either completely constructed or completely deconstructed the tower.  Bonus points to PAX who completely constructed and deconstructed the tower!  (Q wished he’d described this portion of the workout better!)  Exercises were changed to blockees and coupon squats.  PAX were encouraged to modify to burpees and air squats if desired.

### Warmup

SET UP – 2 FIELDS OF PLAY – 1 line of cones with 25 yards distance and 1 line of cones with 50 yards distance.

### Thang

FIELD DAY FUN!!  4 teams were formed with a Captain assigned.

Round 1  - FIELD #1 (25 yards)
Bear Crawl Race
Team does SSH while PAX #1 goes out and back, then PAX #2 etc.

Round 2 – FIELD #1 (25 yards)
Coupon Pass Relay – single file line, starting in the back of the line, PAX do a coupon squat then pass coupon, jailbreak to the front of the line. First team to have all members cross the finish line wins. Last person must cross with coupon!

Round 3 – FIELD #2 (50 yards)
Merkin Jailbreak Race – ALL PAX will be in Plank position entire race. PAX #1 will do 5 merkins then Jailbreak Sprint down and back, PAX #2 Goes. continue until all have gone.

Round 4 – FIELD #2 (50 yards)
Rock, Tree, Bridge Relay – PAX will line up in the following order, ROCK, TREE, BRIDGE.
PAX#1 at the back is the starting ROCK. To begin, they will jump up, then go around the TREE 2 times, then under the BRIDGE back into ROCK position. Then the PAX #2 the TREE will go under the BRIDGE, OVER THE ROCK and back into TREE position. So forth and so on until you cross the finish line.

Round 5 – FIELD #2 (50 yards)
Rifle Carry Weave Race – PAX #1 Rifle Carry and weaves in and out of the line of PAX to the front. When to the front, YELL FORWARD, PAX #2 Goes. ALL PAX are in RIFLE CARRY POSITION THE ENTIRE RACE.

Round 6 – AROUND THE FLAG
CIRCLE JERK – PAX circle up around the flag, everyone will do an exercise that is called out by Q while we go around the circle, each PAX will do 5 Burpees then run around the circle back to their position and end with a Ric Flair for the next person to go. Coupon Curls, Overhead Press, Taint Scrapers, Lawn Mower Pulls were the exercises called out. We switched to 1 Burpee per PAX to make up time.

Numbered off into two teams.
Two Hopscotch lines, Two Teams, Two Balls….because we are men. Two identical hopscotch lines are drawn on parking lot using sidewalk chalk.

It is a race; and there is a prize.
Sprint to the start of the Hopscotch lines.
Hopscotch carrying the ball overhead with both hands. When the end of hopscotch is reached, must throw the ball back to the next guy in line - from the end of the hopscotch line. Man who threw the ball sprints to the back of the line. Any ball drops result in 3 burpees for that team before they can continue.

While hopscotch is taking place each team will be using one coupon and doing one curl and one overhead press before passing the coupon to the next man.  End of the line returns the coupon back to the man he received it from and repeats exercise passing it back up the line to the front. While waiting for the coupon, Goofballs/Lunges/High Knees/Squats are performed.
Every time you touch the coupon, you switch to the next exercise (alternating between the 4).
Completion of race is when the last guy in the lineup completes his loop. Each team counts (out loud) the number of coupon reps and the team with the most reps imposes a 1 burpee penalty for every rep over and above the opposing team.

Losers: 5 burpees
Winners: Side straddle hops until losers finish.
This is in addition to the imposed burpees from whichever team had the most coupon reps.

Any coupon drops result in 10 burpees for the team at the end of each game cycle. (There were none)

Pax had 30 seconds to get in the circle from youngest to oldest in a clockwise fashion.

Stayed in the circle.  Jumped rope 50 times then did the first exercise.  Plank or Al Gore for the six. Then jumped rope 50 times and did the next exercise. Rinse and repeat. Between each set I asked one of the Pax an age-related question. If the answer was incorrect we did three burpees.

Coupon curls X 25
Bent over rows X 25
Flutter kicks X 25 the hard way
Overhead press X 25
Bench press X 25
Taint scrapers X 25
Bonnie Blairs X 25 the easy way
Toe tappers X 25 the hard way

1 Who was the oldest MLB player off all time: Sachel Page.  59

2 Who is the oldest Cardinal right now: Yadie or Wainright 39 and 38

3 Who is the oldest player in MLB right now. Pujols

4 Who was the oldest NFL play: George Blanda.  48

6 Who was the oldest person to win the Masters?  Jack Nicklaus age 46

7 If you and your spouse are both alive at age 65, what is the chance that one of you will make it to age 90? 50 %

9 How many boomers turn 65 each day: 10,000

10 Jeanne Calment of France is the oldest person to have lived that can definitely be documented. 122 years old.

11 Which is a better predictor of longevity: Higher income or higher education?

Took the heavies and moseyed to the field.   Lined them up in a single row.   We then got on all fours in a row snout to tail and passed the heavies through our legs to the Pax behind us. Stood in a line down the hill.  Passed the heavies from one man to another down the hill.  Pax at the end of the line went to the front.  Took the heavies back to the circle.

Got on our sixes in a tight circle with our heads close to each other. Passed the medicine ball around while doing flutter kicks. Rinse and repeat X 10.

### Thang

Partner up first to last (1-12, 2-11, 3-10, etc.)

_The Prison Yard_
Partner 1: Completes active coupon lift (e.g. overhead press)
Partner 2: Maintains a static coupon hold (e.g. overhead hold)
Go until failure, count reps, and high plank until all HIMs are tapped out
Whichever team accumulated the most reps becomes the WARDEN

Starting together on Q's mark - Jailbreak 50m to cone
5 up-downs
Jailbreak back to Prison Yard
First team back has become the ESCAPEE

The WARDEN must set a new coupon movement/static hold pairing (pick from a list of six or his own). Alternate Active/Static assignments between partners each round.
The ESCAPEE must set a new mode of travel, distance, or end of jailbreak movement for the next round.

Repeat Prison Yard --&gt; Jailbreak sequence as time allows

1K Challenge
Each team member strives to do 1,000 reps total (For example: 20 reps each exercise = 100 reps/Station.  Rotate through 10 Stations x 100 reps/Station = 1,000 reps. 25 reps each exercise = 125/Station. Rotate through 8 Stations = 1,000)

## Prefontaine!

### Warmup

5 Bonus Burpees --- PAX knows that they did
Grass Grabbers IC
Goofballs IC
Warming Up Serena Back IC

### Thang

Q broke the PAX into two teams.  In the field there were three obstacles set up and the teams were to race each other until everyone had gone through.

Station 1: Cones were set up in zigzag formation and PAX were to jailbreak around the outside of the cones until the end and then PAX would move to station 2.  At which point the next group of PAX would go.

Station 2: PAX were to carry sandbags to the other side of the field if a sandbag was not at the beginning of station 2 they would go to the end and pick them up and bring them to the beginning before moving on to Station 3

Station 3: Cones were set up like gates as you would see in kayaking or downhill skiing.  PAX had to jailbreak through the cones.  Cones were wide enough for only one PAX at a time.

Station 4: PAX would bear craw then up the hill to a bowl that had numbers inside of it and then take the number back to the parking lot where they held a plank until the SIX.

## Teamwork

### Thang

We pair up in teams of two, and one with three.

Each round 2 exercises. One with coupon, one without.  50 reps each.

One HM starts the exercise with the coupon, while the other travels with his coupon about 100 feet to the other side of the lot.  He leaves his coupon there. Moseys back for his partners coupon and repeats, leaving them both at the far side of the lot.  Meanwhile the first HM switches to the non coupon work when his coupon goes to travel.  When the traveler returns after leaving both coupons, they switch.  HM no 1 now goes and retrieves the coupons while HM no2 now picks up the exercises first without a coupon and then with.  Rinse and repeat until all reps are done.

All travel with coupon is rifle carry and without mosey.  For picking up the six at the end of each round we jogged around the lot until the six came in.  This has an exhausting effect due to keeping the heart rate up the entire workout.

Rounds were:
Dead lifts/merkins
Curls/lunges
Overhead press/burpees
Bench press/side straddle hops
Xxxxx can't remember/squats
Dead lifts/merkins

## Get it Right, Get it Tight!

### Warmup

- Mosey around trees
- Hurdler stretch forward and backwards
- Back bends
- Arm circles forward and reverse
- Smurf Jacks

### Thang

Q spoke of several different points concerning doing proper form and not cutting corners:

- Proper form helps you work out more efficiently so you can use your energy for the extra push rather than wasted movements.
- Hones your focus – meaning your not concentrating on finishing so much as you are on doing the exercise properly
- The better your form the better your results – run faster, lift more and jump higher when you do it right.
- Good form helps you breathe more fully and supports better oxygen intake. That means extra wind beneath your workout wings. You’ll fly higher.
- Helps you perform consistently.  Proper form means you are doing the same thing the same way every time. Consistent form means continued strengthening, toning and performance.
- Full range of motion
- Make sure your muscles are the force that's lifting the weights, not momentum

Earth, Wind, &amp; Fire 11s
Start with 10 Merkins (Earth) and 1 Bobby Hurley (Wind) and cycle through sums of 11 alternating decreasing the Merkins and increasing the BHs by 1 each round. Q started a 2 minute timer at the beginning to mark the start of the Fire. Once timer went off PAX held a two minute plyometric hold. First was wall sit (2 minutes). 2 more minutes of 11s then Q PAX’d to a 1 minute Crab Statue hold. Finished the EWF 11s. Al Gore for the 6.

### Warmup

### Thang

Game Day.
There were 7 stations/locations.  Teams of 3.  All teams began at station 1.  They rolled the die.  Peformed a certain exercise and then moved a certain number of stations.  This continued until time was up.  All bear crawled or bear trapped back to station 1 at the end.  See exercises below.
Station 1
Roll 1 = 20 sumo squats and
move ONE station
Roll 2 = 20 single leg RDL’s HW and move TWO stations
Roll 3 = 20 Lunges HW and
move THREE stations
Roll 4 = 20 Learning to Dances (squat with Moroccan night club arms) and move FOUR stations
Roll 5 = 20 single leg squats EW and move FIVE stations
Roll 6 = 10 of each of the above exercises and DO NOT MOVE and ROLL AGAIN

Station 2
Roll 1, 2 or 3 = 30 thrusters and
move ONE station
Roll 4, 5 or 6 = 30 burpees and
move TWO stations

Station 3
Roll 1 = 10 Big Boy Situps and
move ONE station
Roll 2 = 10 Plank T rotations and
move TWO stations
Roll 3 = 10 American Hammers and move THREE stations
Roll 4 = 10 Penguin Tappers HW and move FOUR stations
Roll 5 = 10 Plank hip rotations and
move FIVE stations
Roll 6 =10 of each of the above exercises and DO NOT MOVE and ROLL AGAIN

Station 4
Roll 1 = 20 coupon squats and
move ONE station
Roll 2 = 20 Bulgarian Squats HW and move TWO stations
Roll 3 = 20 Bent over rows and
move THREE stations
Roll 4 = 20 Chest Presses and
move FOUR stations
Roll 5 = 20  Overhead presses and move FIVE stations
Roll 6 = Do 10 of each of the above exercises and DO NOT MOVE and ROLL AGAIN

Station 5
Roll 1 = 10 Heismans HW and
move ONE station
Roll 2 = 10 speed skaters HW and

## Backblast

### Warmup

Monkey Humpers
Grass Grabbers
Bat Wings

### Thang

Squid Game

The first event of the competitions was: Red Light Green Light

- The caller at one end of the field is in a plank position hold while calling red light/green light. The rest of the PAX try to make it to the end without getting caught via bear crawl. For those unfortunate enough to not freeze on the red light, were sent back to the start to do Burpees or SSH until the next round.

The second event was: Hopscotch

- Setup a Hopscotch grids so that we can move along quickly – 2 PAX per grid. Using a coupon, move the coupon to each number. If the coupon is on #1, jump over #1 to #2 and hopscotch through the rest of the grid. Upon returning to #1, perform 10 reps while your partner is doing SSH. Switch. Run through the PAX and all 10 hopscotch grids.
1. Curls
2. Bent Over Rows
3. Overhead Press
4. Goblet Squats
5. Skull Crushers
6. Taint Scrappers
7. Coupon lunges, easy way
8. Standing side Coupon Crunches – easy way
9. Thrusters
10. Blockees

The third event of the competitions was: Tug of War (F3 style)
PAX split into two teams. Everyone lines up on the center line with a line drawn down the middle horizontally and vertically so that we know the path. One team on one side and the other team on the other side, both teams facing each other. A member of each team alternates at throwing the slam ball as far as they can – watching form. Everyone moves to the latitude of the medicine ball by doing forward lunges or backward lunges respectively. The team with the slam ball on the opposite side of the line after all PAX have thrown the ball is the winner. Apparently PAX was a State Champion in Shot Put. Loosing team does 5 burpees, winning team does 5 burpees.

Since no PAX were eliminated in the competition today, all were sent back to their dorms (flag) for the night.

### Thang

Squid Game

The first event of the competitions was: Red Light Green Light

- The caller at one end of the field is in a plank position hold while calling red light/green light. The rest of the PAX try to make it to the end without getting caught via bear crawl. For those unfortunate enough to not freeze on the red light, were sent back to the start to do SSH until the next round.

The second event was: Hopscotch

- Setup several Hopscotch grids so that we can move along quickly – 2 PAX per grid. Using a coupon, move the coupon to each number. If the coupon is on #1, jump over #1 to #2 and hopscotch through the rest of the grid. Upon returning to #1, perform 10 reps while your partner is doing SSH. Switch. Run through all 10 hopscotch grids.
1. Curls
2. Bent Over Rows
3. Overhead Press
4. Goblet Squats
5. Skull Crushers
6. Taint Scrappers
7. Coupon lunges, easy way
8. Standing side Coupon Crunches – easy way
9. Thrusters
10. Blockees

The third event of the competitions was: Tug of War (F3 style)

- PAX split into two teams. Everyone lines up on the center line with a line drawn down the middle horizontally and vertically so that we know the path. One team on one side and the other team on the other side, both teams facing each other. A member of each team alternates at throwing the slam ball as far as they can – watching form. Everyone moves to the latitude of the medicine ball by doing forward lunges or backward lunges respectively. The team with the slam ball on the opposite side of the line after all PAX have thrown the ball is the winner. Without a definitive winner or loser, everyone does 5 burpees.

## A Tradition Unlike Any Other

### Thang

Today’s core lift focus was the Squat.  Took a moment before the heavy lifting portion to point out some common mistakes we all make when we perform this exercise.

1. We don’t drop down low enough - (Take a slightly wider stance)
2. Our knees drift inward - (Turn your toes out)
3. Our body leans too far forward - (Put your weight in your heels, this will keep your torso upright)
4. We descend too quickly - (Slow down.  Season 2 is about form!)
5. We don’t warm up enough - (Do more burpees!)

8-10 Heavy squats to rep our form x3 -  5 burpees x3

1st ball made = Birdie, rep count reduced to 5
2nd ball made = Par, rep count locked at 10
Miss both putts = Bogey, rep count increased to 15.  Any balls OB added an extra rep.

Each set consisted of - x Merkins, x Squats, x Sandbag Throws (CPRs if you didn’t have a bag)

## Tear Down Your Walls

### Warmup

### Thang

Setup

- Four cones were set up equidistant (about 10 yards) from one another.
- Cone 1 had Glowsticks with exercises the PAX selected written on them.
- Cone 2 had 14 various coupons of different shapes, sizes, and weights
- Cone 3 was just a cone
- Cone 4 was similar to cone 1
- 1 PAX was stationed at Cone 2
- Remaining PAX at Cone 1

Beatdown

- PAX at cone 2 starts tearing down the wall between him and the rest of the PAX, rebuilding it at cone 3
- PAX at cone 1 crack a glowstick and start performing the exercise until PAX at cone 2 finishes building the wall.
- When wall is built, mosey to cone 4, rotating another PAX at the wall now at cone 3.
- PAX at cone 3 starts tearing down the wall between him and the rest of the PAX, rebuilding it at cone 2
- PAX at cone 1 crack a glowstick and start performing the exercise until PAX at cone 2 finishes building the wall.
- Repeat process until all PAX have torn down their wall twice.
- With the extra time available since from the missing gents, the group tore down the wall and rebuilt it away from where we stood, twice.

## Backblast

### Warmup

SSH, Hairy Rockettes, Knee Pulls

### Thang

Q split Pax into 4teams randomlyish.  Team with most points win at the end of 4 8min rounds.  Each team hits each station once with a chance to earn points as outlined below.

Station 1: same as Station 4

Station 2:  a point is earned each time following exercises are completed by ALL Pax in the team (without stealing reps, but assistance with an exercise is permitted/encouraged)

Station 3: Four cones were set up on both sides of the field.  Team was to run around the goals on the field and jump over each cone.  Team adds up complete trips around the circuit and divides by number of team members to determine points.

- all movement must be on all fours (hands and feet)
- Knee hits the ground = must do 1 merkin
- Butt hits ground = 1 sit-up
- Standing = 1 burpee
- There is no out of bounds
- Play is continuous
- Goalie must stay in goal and is exempt from travel rules
- Can't steal out of opponents hands
- Can't move with dice/ball (good rule with dice but when we switched to glow ball we'd rethink it)
- Scorer must do 10 burpees before reinterring play

## the Spirit of Merkin Madness

### Warmup

Hairy rockettes, knee pulls, quad stretch, angle rotations , neck rolls

### Thang

Q instructed Pax to partner up with someone similar speed.  Q had a weinke on display with 8rounds of 2 exercises.  Exercise 1 was always a merkin variation and exercise 2 had a wide range of exercises.  Each round, each partner had to complete 40 of the merkin style exercise, but only one partner could be executing it at a time.  While the one partner is working exercise 1, the other is doing exercise 2, until both have completed 40 of exercise 1.  Then, the partners would Race (not mosey or jailbreak) through the cones set up in a zig zag on the field (Q encouraged PAX to win their races).  Then mosey back and start right into the next round.
